title: sdf orientation test (DMSO), sdf water vs S=O (distinct), mapgrentropy
purpose: Exercises the orientation test of `sdf` [@epsrmanual] for identical four-atom groups and a distinct two-atom second group, together with accumulation from a missing file and `mapgrentropy` on `sdf` coefficients.
fortran: `sdf_rev2.f`: `run_sdf` (keywords), `sdf` (atom-group search by type and distance, pair loop, averaged groups)
system: The EPSR-test configuration `200DMSO400Water.ato`: 200 DMSO (atoms S, C, C, O, 6 H) and 400 water molecules (O1, H1, H1; SPC/E parameters [@berendsen1987]), 3200 atoms at 300 K in a cubic box of side 33.12 Å, a model of the DMSO-water mixtures of Soper and Luzar [@soperluzar1992]. `sdf` computes the same spherical-harmonic coefficients [@soper1994,@graygubbins1984] as `sharm`, but its "molecules" are groups of atoms found by atom types and pair distances (first atom = centre). `dmsotest`: groups S O C C with all six pair distances (±15 %), `test 15 25 ...`, 97 coefficients. `watso`: central water (O1 H1 H1) and the S=O pair of DMSO (1.53 Å ±10 %) as second group, l2 = 0-1, 27 coefficients. `mapgrentropy` adds to the ideal-gas entropy the two-body excess term, an integral of r²·(g - 1 - g ln g) [@baranyai1989], for the radial, spatial and full g, sampling random orientations with `ran1` [@parkmiller1988].
inputs: Input files written by hand from the keyword tables (`setup_symbols_*`), one `keyword value` per line, ended by `q`; `200DMSO400Water.ato` copied from EPSR-test. `dmsotest.SDF.dat` (`averagemol n`); `watso.SDF.dat` with `nsumt 5`; `watso.mapgrentropy.dat`: 80 trials, smoothing `2.0 1 1 1`.
verification: Two passes. `watso`: pass 1 finds no previous file, pass 2 skips the calculation (final `nsumt 7`); the second molecule is written from the averaged second-group coordinates. The orientation test leaves `nsumt 0` and is recomputed in pass 2. Reference build: `sharm`/`sdf` were rebuilt with one comma inserted in the run-time title format (`'(1h(,'//il1fmt`), since gfortran 15.2 otherwise stops with "Missing comma between descriptors" before writing the coefficients; all other programs are the unmodified reference binaries.
notes: Fortran quirk reproduced: `run_sdf` does not include `sharm_sdf.inc`, so the test angles it reads are local variables and the angles actually used by `sdf` are all zero.
